अरे बापरे! वरुण धवन को भारी पड़ गया अपना पुराना घमंड! 😱🔥

वरुण धवन ने Koffee With Karan Season 9 में माना कि Season 6 में Ranbir Kapoor और Ranveer Singh के मुकाबले अपनी आठ लगातार हिट्स का दावा करना उनकी गलती थी।
वरुण का मानना है कि इस बयान ने उनके सक्सेस को नजर लगा दी और उन्हें समझ आया कि असली फ्लेक्स सिर्फ काम से होना चाहिए।
शो पर वरुण और Janhvi Kapoor ने बताया कि उस वक्त उनके पास 11 हिट्स थीं, लेकिन वरुण ने सफाई दी कि वह अब और डींग नहीं हांकना चाहते।
वरुण ने Ajay Devgn की तारीफ करते हुए कहा कि वह सफलता और असफलता दोनों में एक जैसे रहते हैं, और वह वैसा ही बनना चाहते हैं।
वर्कफ्रंट की बात करें तो डेविड धवन की फिल्म Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai सिर्फ 74.83 करोड़ रुपये ही कमा पाई और इसे नेगेटिव रिव्यू मिले।
साथ ही उनके पास Rahul Pandey की अगली फिल्म और Bhediya 2 भी पाइपलाइन में है।

तो क्या आपको लगता है कि सेलेब्स को अपने मुंह से अपनी तारीफ करने से बचना चाहिए? 🤔💬

ctx.title: Varun Dhawan regrets his ‘8 hits in a row’ boast against Ranbir Kapoor, Ranveer Singh on Koffee With Karan, says he jinxed his success
ctx.summary: Reflecting on Koffee With Karan, Varun Dhawan said he regretted once boasting about his run of hit films and now believes an actor should let their work speak.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Varun Dhawan once boasted about his successful films while addressing comparisons with Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor on Koffee With Karan Season 6. During his recent appearance on Koffee With Karan Season 9, the actor admitted that he regretted the boast and expressed his desire to emulate Ajay Devgn.
When Karan Johar spoke about Varun becoming a “meme factory” because of his smile, Varun said that it was Karan who had started it. He further explained that the smile meme originated from a scene in Student of the Year. He added, “I think the whole thing of these things happening, whether it was a push narrative or not a push narrative, what I have realised over the time, after maturing, is that the only flex one should do is with your work. Like, I feel many years back, I came here and flexed about how many hits I had, and eventually, it jinxed me.”
Karan then brought up Varun’s earlier statement about Ranbir and Ranveer. During Koffee With Karan Season 6, when Karan asked Varun who he considered a bigger competitor, Ranbir or Ranveer, Varun replied, “No one. they haven't had what I've had. I've had eight hits in a row.”
Varun and Janhvi Kapoor then pointed out that Varun had had 11 hits by that point, but he was quick to clarify that he did not want it to look like another boast. He added, “I don't want to flex or anything in that matter because I just feel that when you are having success or something becomes success, I think it is something better to be like Ajay Devgn. He doesn't react. He is that one guy I have seen through success or through failure; he looks at you the same way. It's amazing.”
Varun was most recently seen in David Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, which collected only ₹ 74.83 crore worldwide at the box office and received negative reviews. He will reportedly headline the next film by Maamla Legal Hai director Rahul Pandey. The yet-untitled film is said to be backed by Karan Johar's Dharma Productions. However, no official announcement has been made so far.
Varun also has Bhediya 2 in the pipeline. The actor announced the film in 2023, and it was expected to release in 2025. While fans saw Varun reprise his role as Bhediya in Maddock Films' Thamma, they are eagerly awaiting an update on the sequel.
